_about: Shared hero-page fixture (data of 2026-11-10/11): inputs for the matchups, builds, by-league and by-length views of three heroes. `expected` is written by the site's TypeScript: `cd web && UPDATE_MCP_GOLDEN=1 npx vitest run tests/heroGolden.test.ts`. web/tests/heroGolden.test.ts and the server's pytest both check it, so the site and the owner MCP (server/mcp/) cannot drift apart.
